description.value:
You plumb the target's memories to identify the item it's lost in its life that it misses most deeply, then conjure a convincing illusory replica that floats just out of the target's reach. The illusion is visible for the spell's duration, but only the target is mentally drawn to it, depending on the target's Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success You identify and recreate the correct item. The target is drawn to the illusion, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} for 1 round. Any creature other than the target can attack the illusion to end the spell, using your spell DC as the illusion's AC. The illusion shatters if it takes at least 1 damage from the attack, dealing 5d10 mental damage to the spell's target and ending the spell.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target also can't use reactions for the duration of the spell.

Heightened (+1) The mental damage the target takes when an attack destroys the illusion is increased by 1d10.
